name: codex-advisor
description: Get Codex's second opinion — and actually trust it: a different model reviews your code, plans, and research, and Claude fact-checks every finding (Agreed/Disputed/Nuanced/False Positive/Uncited) before you act, catching hallucinated citations. Skills: setup, review, adversarial, rescue, verify, research, status, result, cancel, transfer. Task delegation (rescue) wraps your verbatim request in adaptive, preview-approved prompt blocks. Transfer hands the whole session off to a resumable Codex thread (v1.0.5+). Prompt-running skills accept --model/--effort via config.toml.
